title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The gods and the great Shiraoki have done it! Oh, and you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: With this many plushies, you and I will never run dry of good luck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Please take some too, Trainer! Then we'll have twice the luck! No, even better, we'll have our luck raised to the second power!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now, with our super-duper-ultra-mega-great blessing, no one can stand against us!
